name: Hotel Restaurant Berghof Steinbock
beschreibung: Hotel Restaurant Berghof Steinbock is situated in Mittelberg, surrounded by a peaceful mountain landscape away from through-traffic. The hotel features an authentic alpine ambiance tailored to outdoor enthusiasts. Guests enjoy direct proximity to scenic summer hiking trails and nearby winter ski and cross-country networks. Amenities include a relaxing wellness area with sauna and steam bath, balcony rooms, and half-board dining featuring Austrian classics.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Restaurant Berghof Steinbock in Mittelberg offers quiet alpine comfort, a sauna and steam bath, traditional half-board dining, and direct access to mountain trails.
